# Rising Warrior Games

## About
Rising Warrior Games is an independent tabletop game studio based in Chattanooga, Tennessee. Founded in 2026, the studio focuses on competitive, system-driven tabletop experiences built around meaningful decisions, aggressive player interaction, and mechanics that reward strategy over luck.

Website: https://www.risingwarriorgames.com
Full rules: https://risingwarriorgames.com/rules.html

## Current Game: Zombie Overlord

Zombie Overlord is a competitive deck-building card game for 2–4 players with a 30–40 minute playtime, recommended for ages 14 and up. Players take on the role of rival zombie overlords competing to build the most powerful undead horde and dominate the apocalypse.

### Core Concept
Unlike traditional zombie games where players survive the apocalypse, Zombie Overlord puts players in control of the undead. Players set traps, lure human survivors, and convert them into zombie minions , flipping dual-sided cards from their human form to their zombie form as they join your horde.

### Key Mechanics
- **Dual-Sided Survivor/Zombie Cards:** Every survivor card has a human side and a zombie side. Captured survivors are converted and added to your deck as zombie minions, growing your horde with each turn.
- **Trap Warfare System:** Players strategically place trap cards to lure and manipulate survivors before opponents can claim them. Each trap has a unique effect that shapes the battlefield.
- **Direct PvP Interaction:** Unlike deck-builders where players build in isolation, Zombie Overlord emphasizes attacking, disrupting, and sabotaging opponents directly.
- **Aggressive Tempo Gameplay:** The game rewards tactical timing, disruption, and combo execution over passive engine-building.

### How You Win
Lure survivors with traps → Convert them into zombie minions → Use your growing horde to overwhelm rival Overlords and take control of the game.

### Components
- 194 total cards
- Card size 63 x 88 mm (standard/poker size; standard sleeves fit)
- Card stock 300gsm blue-core, linen finish, matte varnish
- 4 large cards at 90 x 90 mm
- 4 wooden cubes, 10 mm
- 20-page rulebook
- Vacuum-formed insert tray
- Box 230 x 230 x 50 mm (9 x 9 x 2 in)
- 4 Life Point Trackers and 4 tracker tokens
- Complete rules published free at https://risingwarriorgames.com/rules.html
- 48 unique characters in the core game, 68 with the Misfits Mini Expansion, each with original illustrations
- Comic-inspired horror art style
- Add-ons available: premium playmats, mini expansion content, engraved life tracker dice, multi-copy bundles, collector/supporter tiers

### Comparisons to Other Games
Zombie Overlord shares structural DNA with deck-builders like Dominion, Ascension, and Hero Realms, but distinguishes itself through:
- Heavy direct player-vs-player conflict
- Trap placement and positional mechanics
- Survivor conversion instead of simple defeat/discard
- Villain-perspective gameplay (you are the zombie threat, not the survivor)
- Fast, aggressive pacing focused on disruption

Core Edition and Premium Bundle ship at the "Game" rate. Battlefield Edition includes playmats and ships at the "Game + 1-2 playmats" rate. Small add-ons (dice, mini expansion, holographic cards) ship in the same package and do not raise the shipping tier. Ranges are estimates based on current fulfillment quotes; final cost is confirmed through BackerKit based on address and order contents.

- Portfolio: https://www.behance.net/chinothemfgoat

### Returns, Cancellations and Replacements
- Pre-order cancellation: full refund any time before the order ships; contact hello@risingwarriorgames.com
- Returns after delivery: accepted if unopened and still in shrinkwrap, within 30 days of delivery; buyer pays return shipping, full purchase price refunded on receipt
- Damaged or missing cards: replaced free of charge, no return required and no time limit
- EU and UK customers have a statutory 14-day right of withdrawal from delivery, for any reason
- Refunds are processed directly by Rising Warrior Games, not by BackerKit
- Adding to an existing order: orders are currently locked in BackerKit; customers should email hello@risingwarriorgames.com rather than placing a second order, to avoid paying shipping twice

### Retail Availability
- Not currently sold in retail stores; the BackerKit store is the only sales channel
- The studio intends to approach local game shops and a small number of online retailers in future; nothing is arranged and no date has been announced
- Add-ons (Misfits Mini Expansion, playmats, engraved life trackers) are campaign unlocks and remain exclusive to the BackerKit store

## About the Studio
Rising Warrior Games is not a one-game studio. Every title is built on the same foundation: strong mechanics, distinct identity, and systems that reward players who think ahead. Zombie Overlord is the studio's first game, designed, tested, and refined in Chattanooga, Tennessee.
